findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_resume, fetch_job_post, tailor_resume, improve_bullet · Private data: check_resume, open_in_studio, draft_cover_letter · Public sink: fetch_job_post · Destructive: suggest_roles.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_resume, fetch_job_post, tailor_resume, improve_bullet · Private data: check_resume, open_in_studio, draft_cover_letter · Public sink: fetch_job_post · Destructive: suggest_roles

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_resume" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
